premises: Coherent nanoprecipitates in W-based HEAs can relieve stress concentrations and prevent crack initiation, enabling high strength and ductility.
The WMoTaNb alloy system can be processed by spark plasma sintering to form a coherent microstructure.
Adding ~7 at% Cu will form fine, coherent Cu-rich nanoprecipitates at grain boundaries.
Cu-rich nanoprecipitates will enhance thermal conductivity via improved electron/phonon pathways.
The coherent Cu precipitates will remain stable and retain mechanical integrity under cyclic thermal loads at 500–800°C.
